reason: Two simulator-only implementation bugs were confirmed before any FastWAM evaluation: the expert selected a grasp axis wider than the gripper aperture, and the success predicate reused a native lifted-basket table-contact check although this task leaves the basket on the table.
unchanged_from_v0: can and basket assets, models, masses, poses, and sampling ranges
block geometry, mass, color, occluding pose, and revealed pose

expert_grasp.before: Native pose scorer selected among contacts 0,1,2,3 without checking block thickness; all three Missing trials pushed/tipped the block instead of lifting it.
expert_grasp.after: Use contact 1 for the left arm and contact 2 for the right arm so the fingers close across the frozen 0.05 m Y thickness rather than the 0.11 m X width.

success_predicate.before: A can/table actor-pair report was a required failure condition copied from the native lifted-basket task.
success_predicate.after: Can/table actor-pair reporting is diagnostic only. Required success remains basket upright, can center contained, can contacts basket, can-side gripper open, and stable can/basket relative motion for 25 physics steps.
